summary: Completed backend and frontend regression testing for authentication, role dashboards, admin class creation, role-filtered users, logout transitions, student learning content, meeting links, and mobile layout. All executed tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Historical backend logs contain a duplicate-key seed startup failure during an earlier reload; the current upsert-based seed implementation started successfully and no recurrence was observed in this run.
seed_data_creation: Created UI Test Class 3 through the admin UI and TEST_Linear Algebra through the regression API; no seeded records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth, all three role dashboards, admin class create/list refresh, teacher/student role transitions, teacher/student navigation filtering, student attendance/subjects/upcoming work, external new-tab meeting link, and mobile student layout were verified against the public preview URL.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 fixes were verified: AdminView refreshKey causes a post-save collection refetch, and App resets page to Dashboard on logout/login, preventing cross-role page leakage.
